title: How casimir works
text: casimir (Catch Sampling Inference Methods R) simulates small-scale fishery whose true landings known, landing-site surveys try estimate . built training catch assessment surveys: trainees design stratified multi-stage survey, roll sample, raise catch per species estimators FAO training, spin design many times see bias, precision cost. casimir run six layers, plain R function: Seeds derived per stream seed_for(seed, tag), new sample change fishery, designs compared fishery share random draws overlap.

what: 2. The island: landing sites, segments and ranges
title: How casimir works
text: fishery comes logbook simulator cpueTargeting (simulate_logbook()): ten demersal pelagic species shelf--slope grid reef patches temperature gradient, Schaefer dynamics, fleet chooses tactic (reef handline, sediment longline, pelagic troll) cell expected value. casimir switches optional landing layer (landing_settings()): boat home landing site coast, drawn site type segment (site_mix); weight cell choice fish multiplied segment’s reach home site, exp(-(d / range)^2); trip gets fishing day (fishing Sundays, one trip per boat day possible) landing hour (departure + hours fished + travel). island_x() sets Island X FAO training concept Pedro Barros (Data Collection Estimation Fisheries Quantities): nine sites three types (Harbour, Beach, Jetty) three segments. simulation runs several years survey takes place last; earlier years let stocks respond fishing fleet change. fish$landings holds every trip site, date, segment true landed weight species: census survey estimates.

title: How casimir works
text: frame_survey() lists boats site segment (active reference year) fishing days quarter. PSU landing site fishing day; strata site type x quarter, visit records segments, segment raised stratum (site type x quarter x segment). cas_design() sets stages: subsample drawn w_kg / unit_kg baskets, filled species mix landing (multinomial), small subsamples miss rare species. design_cost() counts enumerator-hours per visit, landing kg.

title: How casimir works
text: estimate_catch() raises one stage time: Site-days landings segment count, catch zero. variance step 3 ultimate-cluster estimator stage-1 finite population correction, s^2_h variance site-day totals; second-stage term M_h / m_h sum_i N_i^2 (1 - n_i / N_i) s^2_i / n_i returned var_within. census (site-days, landings, whole landings) recovers true catch exactly, replicates estimator unbiased (tests tests/testthat). CPUE x effort route (route = "effort") multiplies mean catch per landing stratum frame boats x fishing days x boat activity (landings counted per frame boat visited days). agrees PSU route average frame date.
code: Step 1  landing   W_ijs = w_ijs / sum_s(w_ijs) * W_ij Step 2  site-day  W_is  = N_i / n_i * sum_j W_ijs Step 3  stratum   W_hs  = M_h / m_h * sum_i W_is Step 4  total     W_s   = sum_h W_hs V(W_hs) = M_h^2 (1 - m_h / M_h) s^2_h / m_h

what: 5. Catch by segment and the five-year programme
title: How casimir works
text: catch_by(estimate, = "segment") sums stratum estimates species segment (site type, quarter), variances added strata. run_survey() rolls raises design survey year (default last five ten simulated years); frame = "first" keeps frame survey first year throughout, ages boats enter leave. plot_series() shows estimates intervals truth.

text: replicate_design() repeats Roll Raise R times island compares totals truth: relative bias (house edge), CV, coverage 95% intervals RMSE. compare_designs() several designs, days_vs_boats() builds designs equal cost trade site-days landings per visit. Coverage 0.95 expected species whose catches skewed (large landings) strata site-days: normal interval narrow. teaching point, error.

text: catch estimator simulator training multi-stage landing-site surveys (catch assessment surveys). spatial multispecies fishery landing sites, fishing ranges segment calendar (logbook simulator 'cpueTargeting') provides true landings. Trainees design stratified multi-stage survey (landing site x day, landings, species subsamples), draw samples optional planted field artefacts, raise catch per species estimators FAO training, compare designs bias, precision cost replicates. Includes 'shiny' app hide-truth switch trainers.

title: Raise a sample to catch per species (Raise) — estimate_catch
text: species s landing j PSU : W_ijs = w_ijs / sum_s(w_ijs) * W_ij; species s PSU (per segment): W_is = N_i / n_i * sum_j W_ijs; species s stratum h (site type x quarter x segment): W_hs = M_h / m_h * sum_i W_is; total: sum strata. variance step 3 ultimate-cluster estimator stage-1 finite population correction, M^2 (1 - m/M) s^2 / m, s^2 variance PSU totals; within adds second-stage term M/m sum_i N_i^2 (1 - n_i/N_i) s_i^2 / n_i. route = "effort" estimates instead catch = effort x CPUE, effort = frame boats x fishing days x boat activity (landings counted per frame boat visit) CPUE mean step-1 catch per landing stratum.
